name: office-move
description: MoveTrack — local-first, phone-first inventory for an office move

scripts.setup: npm install && (cd server && npm install) && (cd client && npm install)
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.demo: npm run build && node server/scripts/seed-demo.mjs && DB_PATH="$PWD/server/data/demo.db" npm start
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.ci: npm ci && (cd server && npm ci) && (cd client && npm ci)
